part.text: Let me check if the transactions table has any data for 201309:
The yearmonth table has 24,985 records for September 2013, but the transactions table has no data for that period. Let me find products consumed by customers who had consumption in September 2013:

input.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM products p
JOIN transactions_1k t ON p.ProductID = t.ProductID
WHERE t.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201309'
)
LIMIT 100
